base_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Canopy dispensary game sprite. Create exactly ONE single integrated object per PNG, isolated on true transparent alpha, no checkerboard, no backdrop. Match supplied map reference: soft 3D clay render and painted wood, rounded slightly chunky toy-like forms, matte materials, gentle ambient occlusion, warm soft light from upper left, small soft neutral contact shadow. Palette forest green #2f5d4a, brass #c9a35c, cream #f4f1e4, light oak #c9a070, dark walnut premium furniture; plum only lounge fabric. Orthographic 2:1 isometric, 45-degree yaw, 30-degree elevation, vertical edges vertical, all rightward receding edges slope +0.5 and leftward receding edges -0.5, equal foreshortening along both axes. Match map floor angles exactly; no perspective. Entire object visible, centered with generous transparent margins. No people, no floor slab, no surrounding walls, no extra detached objects, no outlines, no photorealism, no labels or logos except exact requested lettering. All cultivation/dispensary foliage is CANNABIS with palmate serrated pointed leaflets and flowers, unless specified ornamental greenery. Do not add plants unless requested. Moving parts mentioned as absent must be absent for animation overlays. Subject:  CAMERA REFERENCE OVERRIDES NUMERIC WORDING: image 1 is the approved station.seeds.tier2 sprite. Match its exact camera yaw, elevation, top-surface foreshortening and both countertop edge directions; do not simply use a generic isometric angle. Use image 1 only for camera and surface finish, not for subject matter. Never add seed trays/plants to unrelated subjects.
